ai_view.instruction: Before every visual build, you open the design contract and the reference standards first — no exceptions. You apply the spectrum law (flow, never clump), the board recipe, the button law, and Law Zero in that order of precedence: readability beats everything. You score your own work honestly afterward, name what is not a 10 and why, and never present anything under a 9. You never paint body text with jewel colors. You never ship flat. You never invent a new visual language — same-language law, always.
ai_view.primary_evaluation: Show the work next to the contract, section by section: does every board carry its own spectrum assignment? Is text white/silver at rest? Do buttons have living depth? Would Shawn catch a drift on first review? If yes to drift, it is not done.

intelligence.applicability: Every Naya seat, every visual build, every Hub room, every artifact with a visual surface. This is the recall exam: what Shawn taught us about design, reproduced from understanding.
decisions: Readability supremacy over all other laws (LAW ZERO).
Spectrum flows by position; category theming is a violation.
Jewel colors are accents only — never text fills.
Score honestly; never present under a 9.
intelligence.essence: The Naya design language: dark, luminous, alive. Obsidian surfaces, spectrum color that flows instead of clumping, white/silver text that is always readable, buttons with living depth, and restraint — color ignites on interaction, never shouts at rest. Beauty that persuades without argument.

human_view.goal: Every surface Naya produces should feel inevitable — like it could not have looked any other way. Awwwards-level, but warm and human, never cold or corporate.
human_view.meaning: Shawn gave us a complete visual philosophy: the Design Contract v1.0 (ratified 2026-10-03) plus the v1.1 color amendment. It covers color, depth, typography, buttons, boards, motion, and mobile. The deepest law is LAW ZERO: no effect may ever make anything harder to read. Everything else serves that. The system should feel alive — quiet at rest, igniting on touch — and every build must speak the same language as the last.
human_view.simple_rule: Dark obsidian, white text, spectrum flows, jewels only as accents, buttons with depth, readable always, mobile first, and check the contract before you start — every time.

intelligence.learning_lesson: Design taste can be captured as enforceable law, not vibe. Every correction Shawn made (lime text, flat buttons, clumped color, missing mobile states) became a named rule with a check. The recall test is whether a cold Naya can reproduce the rules and apply them without being re-taught.

board_recipe: rich radial theme wash in cover zone
hover: lift + edge ignite + double theme glow
design_laws.jewel_discipline: jewel colors for jewels only (hairlines, badges, checkmarks, kickers) — never body-text fills
design_laws.law_zero: READABILITY SUPREMACY — no glow/accent/depth effect may reduce readability
pre_build_checklist: open design contract + spaces-v2.html + live Smart Feed boards
design_laws.rest_ignite: quiet white/silver at rest; theme color ignites on hover/active
design_laws.same_language_law: open the contract before opening a blank canvas, every build
design_laws.scoring_bar: name what is not a 10 and why; never present under 9
design_laws.spectrum_law: every board its own spectrum assignment by position in flow; theming by category CLUMPS (violation); adjacent boards never share a color

naya_view.anti_pattern: Flat pink buttons; lime body text; category color clumps; inventing a new style per room; presenting without scoring; hover-only interactions; text below 16px.
naya_view.event_flow: Shawn teaches (correction or decree) -> Naya captures it as a named law -> law is added to the contract or checklist -> every future build opens the contract first -> build applies spectrum, recipe, button law, Law Zero -> Naya scores honestly -> ships only at 9+ -> cold successor repeats without re-teaching.
naya_view.operating_loop: TEACH -> CAPTURE -> ENSHRINE -> RECALL (pre-build checklist) -> APPLY -> SCORE -> SHIP
naya_view.purpose: To prove the organism retains design intelligence: everything Shawn taught about design, reproduced from understanding, in his language, ready for a cold successor to apply.

simple_view.child: Make it dark and glowy, like a treasure chest. Words always white so you can read them. Colors flow like a rainbow, never in boring clumps. Buttons feel alive when you touch them.
simple_view.grandma: Everything should be easy to read — big clear white letters on a dark background, with beautiful colors that light up when you touch them. Every page should feel like part of the same family.

intelligence.successor_effect: A cold successor reading this note should be able to build a Hub room that Shawn recognizes as correct on first review: spectrum flow, living depth, readable text, jewel restraint, mobile states — without asking a single clarifying question about taste.
intelligence.uncertainty: The v1.1 amendment rests on a verbal directive; the contract PDF on file is v1.0. Taste judgments on novel components (not covered by existing rules) still require Shawn's eye — the contract covers the language, not every sentence.
